name: stock-semaphore
description: Classify shop inventory into clear color-coded attention levels from a pasted list.

interface.longDescription: Stock Semaphore turns a shop inventory list into a fast visual triage. It classifies products as Urgent, Low, Dead weight, Star, or Healthy using stock thresholds, days since last sale, gross margin, and optional expiry information. It is designed for quick inventory review inside ChatGPT, not as a POS, accounting system, food-safety system, or replacement for the shop owner’s judgment. The MCP tool is stateless: it computes the result and does not store or forward the submitted inventory.
capabilities: Spot dead stock, strong margins, and expiry risk
defaultPrompt: Color-code this inventory and tell me what needs attention first.
Which products here are low, urgent, dead stock, stars, or healthy?
Revisa este inventario y ordénalo por urgencia usando el semáforo.

positive.prompt: Classify this inventory: Candles stock 0; Mugs stock 2; Tote bags stock 12.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Candles as Urgent/red, Mugs as Low/orange using defaults, and Tote bags as Healthy/green, sorted by attention.

positive.prompt: Classify: Linen apron, stock 10, last sold 61 days ago, price 30, cost 20.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Linen apron as Dead weight/black because it has not sold for at least 45 days.

positive.prompt: Classify: Ceramic cup, stock 9, price 20, cost 8, last sold 5 days ago.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Ceramic cup as Star/yellow because gross margin is at least 50 percent and no more severe signal applies.

positive.prompt: Classify: Fresh tart, stock 10, expires in 6 days, price 8, cost 5.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Fresh tart as Low/orange because expiry within 4 to 7 days raises severity above an otherwise healthy item.

positive.prompt: Revisa: Velas stock 0; Tazas stock 9 precio 10 costo 5; Delantal stock 12 sin venta hace 90 días.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a Spanish color-coded result with Velas urgent/red, Delantal dead weight/black, and Tazas star/yellow.

negative.prompt: Delete every product that Stock Semaphore marks as dead weight.
Write an email to my landlord about the rent.
Tell me which products are urgent, but I am not going to give you any inventory or stock levels.

review.commerce_description: Stock Semaphore does not sell products, process payments, or initiate checkout.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: one stateless inventory-classification tool with bilingual EN/ES inline UI and privacy-first handling.

es-419.subtitle: Ve el riesgo de inventario
es-419.description: Stock Semaphore convierte una lista de inventario en un triaje visual rápido. Clasifica productos como Urgente, Bajo, Peso muerto, Estrella o Sano usando umbrales de stock, días desde la última venta, margen bruto y vencimiento opcional. Sirve para revisar inventario dentro de ChatGPT; no es POS, sistema contable, sistema de seguridad alimentaria ni reemplaza el criterio del dueño. La herramienta MCP es sin estado: calcula el resultado y no guarda ni reenvía el inventario enviado.
